{%- set v = get_verification_context(doc) -%} {%- set t = v.tenant -%} {%- set fmt = frappe.utils.formatdate -%}

{{ _("Tenant Information for Police Verification") }}

{{ v.building.property_name }} · {{ v.premises_address }}

{% if v.photo %}{% else %}{{ _("Affix photo") }}{% endif %}
{{ _("Full name") }}{{ t.full_name }}
{{ _("Father's / guardian's name") }}{{ t.guardian_name or "" }}
{{ _("Gender") }}{{ t.gender or "" }}
{{ _("Date of birth") }}{{ fmt(t.date_of_birth) if t.date_of_birth else "" }}
{{ _("Mobile") }}{{ t.mobile_no or "" }}
{{ _("Email") }}{{ t.email_id or "" }}

{{ _("Identity") }}

{{ _("Aadhaar number") }}{{ v.aadhaar_full or "" }}
{{ _("Permanent address") }}{{ t.permanent_address or "" }}

{{ _("Work") }}

{{ _("Occupation") }}{{ t.occupation or "" }}
{{ _("Workplace / college") }}{{ t.workspace or "" }}

{{ _("Tenancy") }}

{{ _("Address rented") }}{{ _("Room {0}").format(v.room.room_number) }}{% if v.room.capacity > 1 %}, {{ _("bed {0}").format(doc.bed_no) }}{% endif %}, {{ v.building.property_name }}, {{ v.premises_address }}
{{ _("Staying since") }}{{ fmt(doc.allotment_date) }}
{{ _("Monthly rent") }}{{ v.money(doc.rent_amount) }}
{{ _("Rental agreement") }}{% if v.signature %}{{ _("Signed electronically on {0} ({1})").format(frappe.utils.format_datetime(v.signature.signed_on, "d MMM yyyy, h:mm a"), v.signature.name) }}{% else %}{{ doc.name }}{% endif %}

{{ _("Emergency contact") }}

{{ _("Name and relation") }}{{ t.emergency_contact_name or "" }}{% if t.emergency_contact_relation %} ({{ t.emergency_contact_relation }}){% endif %}
{{ _("Phone") }}{{ t.emergency_contact_phone or "" }}

{{ _("Landlord") }}

{{ _("Name") }}{{ v.landlord_name }}
{{ _("Phone") }}{{ v.landlord_phone or "" }}
{{ _("Address") }}{{ v.landlord_address or "" }}

{{ _("I declare that the information above is true. A copy of the tenant's identity document is attached.") }}

{{ _("Tenant") }}: {{ t.full_name }}
{{ _("Landlord") }}: {{ v.landlord_name }}

{{ _("Printed on {0}. Submit at your local police station or on your state police's tenant verification portal.").format(fmt(frappe.utils.nowdate())) }}
name: Tenant Verification Form
